description: Test suite for configuration issue formatting and normalization functions in 'issue-format.js'. Contains test cases verifying the behavior of functions like 'normalizeConfigIssuePath', 'formatConfigIssueLine', 'normalizeConfigIssue', and 'normalizeConfigIssues'.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLine
methods.description: Formats a single configuration issue line, replacing control characters, optionally normalizing root paths.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLines
methods.description: Formats multiple configuration issue lines with optional delimiters and normalization.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssue
methods.description: Normalizes a configuration issue object for machine readability, simplifying allowed values if hidden count is present.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssuePath
methods.description: Replaces empty, null, or undefined paths with '<root>'.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssues
methods.description: Normalizes an array of configuration issues using 'normalizeConfigIssue'.
